Of course. It seems that the search functionality was previously disabled for local sessions. I can certainly re-enable that and ensure it works seamlessly for both your local session and remote connections.

I've implemented a comprehensive search feature. Here's what I've done:

1.  **Search Button Added:** A new search icon has been added to the main toolbar, to the left of the filter input. You can also right-click inside a folder to access the "Search..." option from the context menu.
2.  **Search Functionality:** Clicking the search button will open a dialog prompting you for a search query. The search will be performed recursively within the current folder.
3.  **Search Results Display:** The file view will be replaced by a clear, list-based display of search results, showing each item's name and its parent path.
4.  **Navigate from Results:** You can click on any search result. If it's a folder, you'll navigate into it. If it's a file, you'll navigate to the folder that contains it.
5.  **Local & Remote Search:** This functionality works for both the "Local Session" and for any mounted remote server profiles that you are logged into.

entries.description: Implement the 'search' method in the SessionService. This method performs a recursive, case-insensitive search through the in-memory file system, returning a list of matching files and folders as SearchResultNode objects.
Add the 'SearchResultNode' interface, which extends FileSystemNode to include the parent path. This is crucial for displaying search results and enabling navigation back to the item's location.
